messages:
Maya CSM: Quick kickoff note for Kappa Health — Hector and team go-live window target is 2/8. Need to align owners, success criteria, and any renewal risks. Who can own enablement checklist?
Jamal AE: I'll own customer liaison and executive updates. Hector, are there any blockers on decision timeline?
Hector (Kappa CTO): No blockers yet. We're pushing to validate HIPAA controls this week. main ask: data partitioning and audit logs.
Priya CSE: I'll take audit log config + KMS integration. Can we get sample data flows and an SSO test account?
Maya CSM: Great — Priya for KMS/audit, Jamal for exec comms. Lena, can you handle verification plan for performance SLOs?
Lena SE: Yep — I'll draft a perf validation plan. Proposed success criteria: 1) 95th perc latency < 300ms for chat, 2) end-to-end auth + audit validated, 3) pilot usage of 10k tokens/day for 2 weeks, 4) no P0 issues.
Hector (Kappa CTO): Those look reasonable. Also need a retention/ingestion policy doc.
Maya CSM: Adding retention policy to deliverables. Quick ownership table:
OnboardBot: ``
- Exec comms: Jamal AE
- KMS + audit: Priya CSE
- Perf plan: Lena SE
- Retention policy: Maya CSM
- Weekly enablement session: Maya CSM + Priya CSE
``
Jamal AE: I'll schedule weekly syncs. Proposed cadence: Mon 10am PT — ok for Kappa? :calendar:
Hector (Kappa CTO): Monday works. Please add product and infra engineers to first two sessions.
Priya CSE: Requesting test creds + small sample corpus by Friday so we can pre-run checks.
Maya CSM: Noted — Jamal, can you confirm delivery dates from Kappa?
Jamal AE: looping in Hector — Hector, can you confirm sample data delivery by EOD Friday?
Hector (Kappa CTO): We'll drop a sanitized sample into the S3 link you shared. ETA Friday 5pm PT.
Lena SE: For perf testing, I'll need expected traffic profile (concurrent sessions, seq lengths). Hector, a quick table would help.
Hector (Kappa CTO): I'll send a traffic sketch tomorrow morning.
Maya CSM: Renewal risk note: customer flagged procurement timeline with legal — if HIPAA review slips >3w, renewal conversation may shift. Flagging as medium risk.
Priya CSE: I'll add a short checklist for HIPAA artifacts to reduce back-and-forth.
Jamal AE: Also capturing customer feedback plan: weekly NPS-lite pulse after each enablement session + end-of-pilot retrospective. Maya, can you capture survey template?
Maya CSM: Yep will draft a 5-question pulse and share in channel.
OnboardBot: Reminder: onboarding playbook template v2 uploaded -> https://console.redwood.ai/playbooks/kappa (view-only).
Lena SE: I'll post the perf validation checklist as a gist before Monday.
Maya CSM: Next steps recap (short):
- Jamal: confirm sample data + schedule weekly meetings
- Priya: KMS/audit checklist + run initial connectivity tests
- Lena: perf plan + test harness
- Maya: retention policy doc + pulse survey
- Hector: sample data + traffic sketch
Target milestone: pilot start 2024-02-08, two-week pilot then retro.
Jamal AE: thumbs up :thumbsup: Any other risks?
Hector (Kappa CTO): Only one: our procurement team might request SOC2 cert copy. I'll surface if that happens.
Maya CSM: Good call — Jamal please prep cert portfolio link if needed.
Priya CSE: I'll run a dry run connectivity test on Monday morning pre-sync.
Maya CSM: Perfect. I'll share an enablement agenda and invite list by EOD today. Thanks everyone.
